# Paths that belong to the target

The service account's home is /home/svc_apache/app/config.php and the
Administrator desktop holds the flag file at
`C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\root.txt`.

Public profile data lives in `C:\Users\Public\Documents\export.csv`.

System paths are untouched: /root/.ssh/id_rsa, /etc/shadow, /var/www/html,
/opt/tools, /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt.
